basic_info.description: Rare Central Sunset 1930s 2BD/2BA Spanish Mediterranean on a stunningly landscaped deep lot, with ample space to expand, all in an amazing neighborhood, close to the local schools, shopping, dining & parks. 1581 29th Ave greets visitors w/a bright FLR featuring vaulted ceilings, picture windows, and a central fireplace. Nearby is a big FDR and B-fast room w/built-ins, both adjoining the well-appointed galley kitchen w/good light & a butler's pantry. Tucked quietly at the home's rear are two ample BDS w/good closet space, and a big full BA w/shower & tub. Fresh paint, parquet flrs, lots of period charm, run throughout. Recent updates include a newer roof & dual-paned windows. Downstairs is a large garage w/ample parking, laundry, storage, and a big finished bonus room and full BA, both ready for a possible primary suite, family rm, or in-law conversion (buyers to verify all past & possible uses for themselves). Out back on the deep lot is a professionally landscaped California native garden w/portico, brick patio, custom planter boxes, and a quiet sitting area to enjoy the abundant nature the garden attracts. Excellent location, steps from GG Park, Ocean Beach, Sunset Rec. Center, top-rated schools, Noriega & Irving St. shopping and dining, and easy Muni commute access.
